Congiuntivo presente (Present Subjunctive)
Expressing opinion, doubt, necessity, and emotion
penso che / credo che / bisogna che + subjunctive
Penso che lui abbia ragione.
pehn-soh keh loo-ee ahb-byah rah-joh-neh
I think that he is right.
indicative vs. subjunctive
Opinion verbs (pensare, credere) trigger the subjunctive in standard Italian.
Condizionale presente
Polite requests, wishes, and hypothetical results
verb stem + -ei, -esti, -ebbe, -emmo, -este, -ebbero
Vorrei prenotare un tavolo per due.
vohr-reh-ee preh-noh-tah-reh oon tah-voh-loh pehr doo-eh
I would like to book a table for two.
Particella ne e ci
Replacing quantities/topics (ne) and places/things (ci)
ne (of it/them, some) | ci (there, about it)
Quanti libri hai? Ne ho tre.
kwahn-tee lee-bree ah-ee neh oh treh
How many books do you have? I have three of them.
Periodo ipotetico II (2nd Conditional)
Unreal or unlikely present/future conditions
Se + congiuntivo imperfetto, condizionale presente
Se avessi più tempo, viaggerei di più.
seh ah-vehs-see pyoo tehm-poh vyahj-jeh-reh-ee dee pyoo
If I had more time, I would travel more.
